name: Step: All-In-One Money App
description:
Step is the ultimate money app to help you build credit, grow your savings, borrow money with no interest, and get cash back. Trusted by over 7 million users, Step puts more money in your pocket and helps you become more financially independent, giving you the freedom to chase your dreams. 

Why Step: 

BUILD CREDIT FOR FREE: The average Step user boosts their credit score by 57 points in their first year. 

CASHBACK ON EVERY PURCHASE: Get at least 1% cashback on every card purchase and up to 10% at rotating merchants.

EARN 3% ON YOUR SAVINGS: Unlock one of the highest savings rates in the country, FDIC-insured up to $1M. 

EARN OVER $200/MONTH: Get paid to play games, take surveys, and more. 

GET UP TO $250 WITH STEP EARLYPAY: Don’t wait for payday. Get fast cash when you need it most. No interest. No stress. No direct deposit needed. Access between $20 - $250.

More Reasons to Love Step: 
• Free credit building at any age 
• Step Visa Card accepted everywhere Visa is around the world 
• Safe and secure with built-in fraud protection with Visa’s Zero Liability Policy 
• Merchant blocking features 
• No security deposit, no interest, and no hidden fees 




*Step is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services provided by Evolve Bank & Trust, Member FDIC. 
1. Not everyone will qualify. Must be 18 years or older. To be eligible for loans over $100 a minimum qualifying direct deposit to your Step account is required. Offer can go up with on-time payments. Instant Transfers are available for a fee. Instant Transfers typically occur in seconds, but may take up to 30 minutes. Not all users will qualify. 
2.  Average based on analysis conducted by TransUnion based on 594 Step users aged 21-27 with a positive increase in their credit score within a 360-day period beginning from the first instance of Step reporting to the credit bureau.
